answer: A workable design: require consistent long-form persona presence across two disconnected communities. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. An identity earns only when its kernel recurs, its walnut survives audit, and a velvet from an unlinked peer confirms it.
